note.summary: This decision closed 2026-07-28 with guide sections left without accessible names because naming all 10 sections would create rotor noise rather than help. It remains closed unless evidence from real screen-reader users supports re-opening it.

note.whyItMatters: The record prevents a reflexive accessibility change that would make long guide pages noisier for screen-reader navigation.
note.filesToTouch: none — decision ticket
note.readExactly: AGENTS.md, TASKVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, this ticket
note.constraints: Each guide page has 10 `<section class="guide-block">` with no `aria-label`, no `aria-labelledby` and no `id` on the `h2`s, so they map to `generic` rather than `region`.
